_README: Edit 'branches' to customize your skill tree. The center node label is automatically set to your brand name from config/links.ts (SITE.name). To add a whole new branch: copy _EXAMPLE_BRANCH and paste it as a new entry inside 'branches' (give it a unique 'id'). To add a skill to an existing branch: copy _EXAMPLE_SKILL into that branch's 'skills' list. After editing, refresh the dev server (npm run dev) to see changes.
